english: Use the past simple for a finished action at a finished time.
persian: برای کاری که در زمان مشخص گذشته تمام شده از گذشته ساده استفاده کن.
examples: We booked the room last week.

english: Use am/is/are + verb-ing for an action happening now or a temporary situation.
persian: برای کاری که الان در جریان است یا وضعیت موقت، از am/is/are + ing استفاده کن.
examples: I am waiting for the manager.
We are staying with friends this week.

english: Use going to for an intention or plan, and will for an immediate decision or prediction.
persian: برای برنامه و قصد از going to و برای تصمیم لحظه‌ای یا پیش‌بینی از will استفاده کن.
examples: I am going to study abroad.

english: Use can/could for ability or requests. Could is usually softer and more polite in requests.
persian: can/could برای توانایی یا درخواست‌اند؛ could در درخواست‌ها معمولاً مؤدبانه‌تر است.

english: Use adjective + -er or more + adjective to compare two things, usually followed by than.
persian: برای مقایسه دو چیز از صفت + er یا more + صفت و معمولاً than استفاده کن.
examples: This room is cheaper than that one.

english: Some nouns such as information, advice, and luggage are uncountable. Do not add -s; use some or a piece of when needed.
persian: اسم‌هایی مثل information، advice و luggage غیرقابل‌شمارش‌اند و s جمع نمی‌گیرند.
examples: I have two pieces of luggage.
